menu_options.manual: Add a strip already on your Thread network
menu_options.ble_scan: Add a new (factory-reset) strip via Bluetooth

manual.title: Add a Nanoleaf LTPDU strip
manual.description: Add a strip that's already on your Thread network. Its label ID is printed on the physical device (e.g. "AB12").

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found "{label_id}" on your Thread network. Enter its auth token to add it.

ble_scan.title: Select a strip
ble_scan.description: Choose the factory-reset strip to pair.

ble_pairing_code.title: Enter the pairing code
ble_pairing_code.description: Enter the pairing code printed on {label_id}'s physical label.

progress.ble_pairing: Pairing with the strip over Bluetooth…
progress.joining_thread: Sending your Thread network credentials to the strip…

abort.ble_onboarding_complete: {label_id} was paired and sent your Thread network credentials. It should appear automatically within a minute or two once it joins the mesh.
abort.no_thread_dataset_available: Home Assistant doesn't have an active Thread network dataset available. Try entering the network details manually instead.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect — check the address, port, and auth token.
error.no_devices_found: No factory-reset strips found nearby. Make sure it's powered on and hasn't already been paired.
error.ble_pairing_failed: Pairing failed — double check the pairing code and try again.
error.thread_credentials_rejected: The strip rejected the Thread network credentials.
error.invalid_thread_credentials: Those Thread network details don't look right — check the PAN ID, extended PAN ID, and network key are valid hex.
